clusters.mechanism: Rejected routing load in RetryModels never clears the loading state or offers a retry, leaving the picker stuck loading and submission disabled.
Clearing default effort omits it from the PATCH payload, so the merge on the server preserves the old effort value.
Catalog history is stored only in component-local session state, so it is lost on unmount and misses changes from other clients.

Unrequested Playwright devDependency with a root postinstall that downloads Chromium on every install, causing install and gate failures when the CDN is unreachable and making unrelated tests depend on it.
Every provider SSE event triggers an undebounced full Setup refresh with many requests (including a preview per role×cell and a stats query), causing a request storm.
The same error is rendered twice, once in RunModelPicker and again in RetryModels' own alert box.
The change greatly exceeds the stated source-line budget, with repetitive inline code.
